name: Global Chamfer Distance
definition: Measures global geometric accuracy by computing bidirectional CD between uniformly sampled point sets from the reconstructed mesh surface ($\mathbf{S}_r$) and ground truth surface ($\mathbf{S}_{\text{gt}}$).
summary: Global Chamfer Distance measures global geometric accuracy by computing bidirectional distances between uniformly sampled point sets, distinguishing itself by evaluating entire surface geometry rather than specific features.
